gbifID.description: Unique global biodiversity record identifier assigned by GBIF.

datasetKey.description: Uniform dataset identifier linking all records to the same GBIF dataset.

occurrenceID.description: Unique iNaturalist observation URL linking to each recorded Sesamum indicum occurrence.

kingdom.description: Biological kingdom classification, always Plantae for these observations.

phylum.description: Plant kingdom classification for each observation, all entries belong to Tracheophyta.

class.description: Class is Magnoliopsida, the plant class for all recorded Sesamum indicum observations.

order.description: Taxonomic order for all observations is Lamiales.

family.description: Family classification for all records is Pedaliaceae.

genus.description: Taxonomic group for all entries is Sesamum.

species.description: Taxonomic species designation, consistently Sesamum indicum.

infraspecificEpithet.description: Infraspecific epithet designating subspecies or variety of Sesamum indicum.

taxonRank.description: Taxonomic rank of the observation, indicating species or subspecies classification.

scientificName.description: Botanical name of the recorded plant, including subspecies distinctions.

verbatimScientificName.description: Scientific name of the observed Sesamum indicum specimen, including subspecies variants.

verbatimScientificNameAuthorship.description: Scientific name authorship information is unavailable for all records.

countryCode.description: ISO 3166‑1 alpha‑2 country codes identify observation locations.

locality.description: All entries missing; no locality information recorded.

stateProvince.description: Administrative region where each Sesamum indicum observation was recorded.

occurrenceStatus.description: All records denote a present occurrence of the species.

individualCount.description: Individual count data missing for all records.

publishingOrgKey.description: Identifier of the organization that published the observation record.

decimalLatitude.description: Geographic latitude in decimal degrees for each observation.

decimalLongitude.description: Geographic longitude of observation in decimal degrees.

coordinateUncertaintyInMeters.description: Spatial uncertainty radius around each observation, measured in meters.

coordinatePrecision.description: No coordinate precision data recorded for any observations.

elevation.description: Elevation data is missing for all records.

elevationAccuracy.description: Elevation accuracy data unavailable for all records.

depth.description: Depth data missing for all records.

depthAccuracy.description: Accuracy of recorded depth values is missing for every observation.

eventDate.description: Observation date and time of each record.

day.description: Day of month when each observation was recorded.

month.description: Month of observation, integer values ranging from 1 (January) to 12 (December).

year.description: Observation year of each record, ranging from 2002 to 2026.

taxonKey.description: Taxonomic identifier linking each observation to a specific species classification.

speciesKey.description: Species identifier for Sesamum indicum observations, identical across all records.

basisOfRecord.description: All records are human observations of Sesamum indicum occurrences.

institutionCode.description: Data source identifier for observations, consistently iNaturalist.

collectionCode.description: All entries are labeled as observations.

catalogNumber.description: Unique numeric identifier assigned to each Sesamum indicum observation record.

recordNumber.description: No data recorded for this field.

identifiedBy.description: Name of the observer or identifier who recorded each Sesamum indicum occurrence.

dateIdentified.description: Date and time when each Sesamum indicum observation was recorded.

license.description: License type for dataset, using Creative Commons BY‑NC 4.0, BY 4.0, or CC0 1.0.

rightsHolder.description: Names of individuals or organizations holding usage rights for each observation.

recordedBy.description: Observer names who documented each Sesamum indicum occurrence.

typeStatus.description: No information available for this attribute.

establishmentMeans.description: Establishment means data missing for all records.

lastInterpreted.description: Timestamp of last interpretation for each observation.

mediaType.description: Media type of observation, usually a still image.

issue.description: Data quality flags indicating coordinate rounding, continent derivation, and missing taxon identifiers.

sesamum_indicum.description: 1002 Sesamum indicum observations (2003‑2026) with taxonomy, location, date, and metadata.

description: Records 1002 sesamum indicum occurrences from 2003 to 2026 for biodiversity monitoring.
